inventory_event_product_id_status: Inventory events do not expose a direct product id in af_content_id. af_search_inventory has af_search_string; af_content_view_inventory has only af_content.
matching_policy: Top inventory search strings are normalized and matched to product names with exact, prefix, or substring rules. Results are candidate attributions.
lead_lag_policy: Correlation compares daily inventory search counts with POS sales for the same candidate product after lag_days. lag_days=1 means search today vs POS sales tomorrow.
